note: Seed data for the BMA enabling task catalogue. Duration P50/P80/P90 values are seeded from planner experience at Saraji and Caval Ridge. SampleSize is 0 indicating these are estimates — they will be updated monthly as real completion data accrues in the EnabledTasks list. DoneDefinition fields are critical — they remove ambiguity about what 'complete' means at shift level.

items.Title: Backfill Dozer
items.DoneDefinition: Backfill material placed to design level and compacted. Access restricted by supervisor inspection. No voids or subsidence risk. Signed off by supervising operator.
items.PlannerNotes: Volume and haul distance are the primary duration drivers. Confirm dozer availability with Production super before scheduling.

items.Title: Break-in Task
items.DoneDefinition: Break-in blast design approved by Blast Coordinator. Drill pattern complete and charged. Exclusion zone established. Blast fired and site cleared for re-entry.
items.PlannerNotes: Requires 48h lead time for blast permit. Coordinate with Geotechnical for wall stability pre-inspection.
items.TypicalPredecessors: Drill Prep Waste, Drill Prep coal
items.TypicalSuccessors: Post Blast works, Earthworks Area Setup

items.Title: Break-in Task FLOAT
items.DoneDefinition: Float (low-loader) has successfully transported equipment to break-in location. Equipment has been de-rigged and is operational at destination. Road crew sign-off recorded.
items.PlannerNotes: Requires confirmed road condition assessment and load permit. Check float availability in fleet roster.

items.Title: Bund works
items.DoneDefinition: Bund constructed to minimum 1m height (or site standard) with no gaps. Bund is continuous along entire edge. Surveyed and meets design spec. Supervisor walkdown complete.
items.PlannerNotes: Material source must be confirmed before scheduling. Check if reject material is available — preference over topsoil.

items.Title: Bury Polypipe
items.DoneDefinition: Polypipe buried to minimum 300mm depth along approved route. All joints tested for leak integrity. Line pressure tested at operating pressure. Route marked and recorded on site services map. Pump crew sign-off.
items.PlannerNotes: Pipe route must be approved by Survey before work commences. Confirm pipe stock availability in stores.

items.Title: Cable works
items.DoneDefinition: HV or LV cable relocated, terminated, and tested by qualified electrician. Cable protection in place where required. Isolation permit closed out. Electrical inspector sign-off. Cable route updated on site services drawing.
items.PlannerNotes: Requires electrical permit and isolation plan — allow 5 days minimum lead time. HVMS involvement mandatory for HV works.

items.Title: Cut/Fill Ramps
items.DoneDefinition: Ramp constructed to design grade (max 10% or site standard). Width meets minimum haul road standard. Surface passable for all haul trucks and equipment. Ramp crowned for drainage. Bunded where required. Surveyed to design. Mine Manager or delegate sign-off.
items.PlannerNotes: Design must be approved by Survey before dozer commences. Confirm bench material volume for fill. Often the longest-duration enabling task on the critical path — schedule P80 not P50.
items.TypicalPredecessors: Earthworks Area Setup, Post Blast works, Scrub Clearing

items.Title: Dewater
items.DoneDefinition: Target area dewatered to design level — pit floor or bench accessible without significant standing water. Pumps remain running until confirmed by supervisor walkdown. Water level recorded in dewater log. Pump crew sign-off.
items.PlannerNotes: High variability task — duration is weather and inflow dependent. Always use P80 for planning. Coordinate pump availability early — pump crew is a shared resource constraint.
items.TypicalSuccessors: Dragline walk, Drill Prep coal, Drill Prep Waste, Earthworks Area Setup

items.Title: Dragline walk
items.DoneDefinition: Dragline has walked to target block under its own power. Dragline operator confirmed at destination. Block walk path inspected post-move for any ground disturbance. Walk report completed by Dragline Superintendent.
items.PlannerNotes: Walk path must be cleared and inspected by Dragline super minimum 24h before walk. Coordinate with Production for road clearance during walk window. Dragline walk is typically the highest-consequence enabling task — any delay directly delays extraction.
items.TypicalPredecessors: Cut/Fill Ramps, Goline works, Dewater, Low Wall Ramp Prep

items.Title: Drainage works
items.DoneDefinition: Drainage structures (table drains, catch drains, sumps, diversion banks) constructed to design. Water flows clear of haul roads and work areas. Drainage route confirmed by supervisor walkdown after rainfall simulation (hose test).
items.PlannerNotes: Often required in conjunction with road works. Plan drainage before road sheeting — sheeting on undrained road is a rework risk.
items.TypicalSuccessors: Dewater, Sump / trench works, Earthworks HV Roads

items.Title: Drill Prep coal
items.DoneDefinition: Coal seam bench cleared and levelled to design RL. Drill rig access confirmed. Drill pattern surveyed and pegged. Blast Coordinator has approved drill design. D&B Superintendent sign-off.
items.PlannerNotes: Coordinate with Geotechnical for seam identification before pegging. Confirm drill rig type matches seam hardness requirements.
items.TypicalPredecessors: Dewater, Post Blast works, Earthworks Area Setup

items.Title: Drill Prep Waste
items.DoneDefinition: Waste bench prepared to design RL. Drill pattern surveyed and pegged. Presplit line confirmed if required. Blast design approved. D&B Superintendent sign-off.
items.PlannerNotes: Confirm bench floor material — wet or soft material significantly extends drill prep time. Check presplit requirement with Geotechnical.
items.TypicalPredecessors: Post Blast works, Earthworks Area Setup

items.Title: Dumps works
items.DoneDefinition: Dump area constructed to design lift. Surface traffickable and drained. Haul road to dump operational. Bund in place at crest. Geotechnical monitoring points installed if required. Production Superintendent sign-off.
items.PlannerNotes: Dump design must be current — check with Survey that no design changes have occurred since last review. Coordinate with Rehabilitation for topsoil management if dump is final.

items.Title: Earthworks Access
items.DoneDefinition: Access track to work area formed to minimum one-lane standard. Width sufficient for intended vehicles. No obstacles. Drainage not impeded. Supervisor confirming access is safe for intended traffic type.
items.TypicalSuccessors: Earthworks Area Setup, Earthworks HV Roads

items.Title: Earthworks Area Setup
items.DoneDefinition: Work area cleared, levelled, and secured. Safe exclusion zone established. Signs and bunds in place. Equipment staging area confirmed. Supervisor inspection and sign-off.
items.TypicalPredecessors: Scrub Clearing, Topsoil Removal, Earthworks Access
items.TypicalSuccessors: Cut/Fill Ramps, Bund works, Drainage works

items.Title: Earthworks HV Roads
items.DoneDefinition: Heavy vehicle road constructed to BMA road standard: design width, grade, crown, drainage, bunding. Signed off by Mine Manager or delegate. Road included on site traffic plan. Survey pegs for design confirmation.
items.PlannerNotes: Longest-lead road works task. Survey design must be approved before dozer commences. Confirm sheeting material availability — reject or gravel.
items.TypicalPredecessors: Earthworks Area Setup, Scrub Clearing, Topsoil Removal

items.Title: Earthworks LV Roads
items.DoneDefinition: Light vehicle access track formed and passable for 4WD vehicles. No deep ruts. Drainage not impeded. Crown evident. Supervisor sign-off.

items.Title: Emergency Access
items.DoneDefinition: Emergency egress route established, clearly signed (E-Access signage), and accessible for emergency vehicles and personnel on foot. Route logged in site Emergency Response Plan. Safety team sign-off.
items.PlannerNotes: CRITICAL — do not allow major works to commence without confirmed emergency access. Non-negotiable safety prerequisite.

items.Title: Float
items.DoneDefinition: Equipment loaded, transported, and unloaded at destination. Equipment is operational and operator confirmed on location. Float return confirmed. Transport record completed.
items.PlannerNotes: Float availability is a shared constraint across sites — book early. Road width and condition must be confirmed as float-capable.

items.Title: Goline Maintenance
items.DoneDefinition: Goline (ground level cable or pipe) inspected, repaired, and tested. Any damaged sections replaced. Route clear of obstruction. Electrical test complete and recorded. Responsible engineer sign-off.

items.Title: Goline works
items.DoneDefinition: Goline route established and cable/pipe installed to design. All terminations made. Electrical testing complete and passed. Route marked on services plan. Responsible engineer sign-off.
items.PlannerNotes: Goline route must be surveyed and approved before installation. Dragline walk cannot proceed until Goline is confirmed operational.

items.Title: Intersections works
items.DoneDefinition: Intersection formed to design. Sight lines clear. Signage installed (Stop/Give Way as per site traffic plan). Surface drained. Traffic controllers removed or modified. Supervisor and Traffic Management sign-off.
items.TypicalPredecessors: Earthworks HV Roads, Earthworks LV Roads

items.Title: Low Wall Ramp Prep
items.DoneDefinition: Low wall ramp prepared to design grade, width, and surface standard. Ramp walkable by Dragline super. Bunded at crest. No loose material on ramp surface. Dragline Superintendent confirms ramp acceptable for dragline walk.
items.PlannerNotes: Dragline Superintendent must inspect and approve the ramp before walk. Low Wall Ramp Prep is typically on the critical path for every dragline repositioning.
items.TypicalPredecessors: Dewater, Post Blast works, Earthworks Area Setup

items.Title: People Delay
items.DoneDefinition: People delay resolved — personnel returned to work, replaced, or activity rescheduled. Cause documented in shift log.
items.PlannerNotes: Used to record delays caused by insufficient personnel (absence, redeployment, training, FIFO logistics). Important for FTE demand analysis.

items.Title: Post Blast works
items.DoneDefinition: Post-blast inspection complete. All misfires cleared and reported. Muck pile assessed for excavation readiness. Exclusion zone lifted. D&B Superintendent confirms area cleared for next activity.
items.PlannerNotes: Misfire management can significantly extend this task — allow P80 for scheduling. Do not allow Production to enter blast area until D&B Superintendent confirms clear.
items.TypicalSuccessors: Earthworks Area Setup, Backfill Dozer, Drill Prep Waste

items.Title: Pumps works
items.DoneDefinition: Pumps installed, primed, and operational at required position. Discharge line routed and secured. Electrical connection confirmed and tested. Pump crew confirmed monitoring schedule. Pump log started.
items.PlannerNotes: Pump availability is the primary constraint for the Pump Crew — confirm pump fleet status before scheduling. Account for travel and setup time on remote pit locations.
items.TypicalPredecessors: Earthworks LV Roads, Sump / trench works

items.Title: Relocation
items.DoneDefinition: Equipment or personnel relocated to new work area. Equipment confirmed operational at destination. Departure area confirmed cleared. Relocation record updated.

items.Title: Rip & Grade Presplit
items.DoneDefinition: Presplit line ripped and graded to design profile. No loose material left on face. Geotechnical inspection complete and pass recorded. Survey confirmation of design RL.
items.PlannerNotes: Requires Geotechnical sign-off — coordinate with Geotech team before scheduling.

items.Title: Scrub Clearing
items.DoneDefinition: Vegetation cleared from designated area to approval line. Material stockpiled or mulched as per Rehabilitation plan. No root balls or stumps remaining in work footprint. Environmental officer sign-off. Cleared area surveyed.
items.PlannerNotes: Environmental approval must be in place before clearing commences — allow 10 working days for permit. Area to be cleared must be GPS-defined and approved.

items.Title: Sheeting Gravel
items.DoneDefinition: Road sheeted with gravel to minimum 150mm compacted depth. Surface smooth and drained. No material migrating onto other roads. Supervisor inspection. Road re-opened to traffic.
items.PlannerNotes: Confirm gravel stockpile location and volume before scheduling. Haul distance from stockpile to road is the key duration driver.
items.TypicalPredecessors: Earthworks HV Roads, Earthworks LV Roads, Drainage works

items.Title: Sheeting Rejects
items.DoneDefinition: Road sheeted with reject material to minimum 150mm compacted depth. Surface trafficable and drained. Supervisor inspection complete. Road re-opened.
items.PlannerNotes: Reject availability must be confirmed with CHPP or coal handling before scheduling. Reject sheeting is preferred over gravel on dump roads for cost.

items.Title: Sump / trench works
items.DoneDefinition: Sump or trench excavated to design dimensions and location. Sump confirmed by Survey. Pump inlet accessible. Bund around sump complete. Pump Crew confirmed sump location in pump log.

items.Title: Topsoil Removal
items.DoneDefinition: Topsoil stripped from designated footprint to design depth. Topsoil stockpiled at approved location and bunded. No mixing of topsoil with overburden. Volume confirmed by Survey. Environmental officer sign-off.
items.PlannerNotes: Confirm topsoil stockpile location with Rehabilitation before scheduling. Topsoil is a valuable resource — do not allow mixing with overburden.
